question: The area of the base of a right circular cone is 7546 cm² and its height is 15 cm. The volume of the cone is cm³ is (Use pi = (22)/(7)):
solution:
**Given:**

Area of base of right circular cone = 7546 cm²

Height = 15 cm

**Concept used:**

Volume of cone = (1/3) πr²h

The base area of cone = πr² where,

Height = h and Radius = r

**Calculation:**

Area of base of right circular cone = 7546 cm2

πr² = 7546

⇒ r² = 2401

⇒ r = 49

Volume of cone = (1/3) π × 49² × 15 

⇒ 1/3 × 22/7 × 49 × 49 × 15 = 37730

**∴ The volume of the cone is 37730.**
